verdict: The legacy-side wiring clears the bar and in several places sets it. All 20 acceptance criteria pass against the real files. The diff against 46bd111 is 14 hunks, +606/-14 on public/index.html, and every one of the 14 deleted lines is a line the brief required to be replaced (the BUILD_VERSION stamp, the seven-line drifted opNiceName map, the two _ppGenListing lines, and the city script tag whose surrounding comment was extended rather than trimmed). Zero reindentation, zero restructuring, zero pre-existing comment deleted or reworded. node _synckcheck.mjs public/index.html reports ALL CLEAN; package.json and package-lock.json show no diff. Every hard prohibition holds by grep: _convoyCanSend, _convoySpend, _convoyGrant, CONVOY_TRUCKS, GARAGE_RIG_FX, GARAGE_RIGS, _jbConvoys, _vmResearchMult, playerOwnsVehicle and worker.js are all absent from the diff except one read-only mention of GARAGE_RIGS inside a comment explaining why the bridge may never grant one; no discord/webhook/wallet_credit/FormData/createObjectURL text; no raw Profile.gems assignment added (the only match is a comment quoting ppBuyVehicle's forbidden line as the pattern NOT to copy). The bridge key set is exactly 36 keys and matches transport.bridge.js's NULL_BRIDGE key-for-key, with only the documented _null marker extra on the module side. Every accessor is a function; the only two non-function entries are the two idle constants, and the comment makes that a rule a reviewer can check by eye. Most importantly the comments are load-bearing and their citations are true: I spot-checked the mythic-roadtrain-at-3.4M-on-weight-1 claim, the lowercase 'common' rarity id the starter-rig picker keys off, the mythic:transport-ready dispatch, MythicTransport.rigCatalog, sw.js:485's network-first block, OP_LABELS actually containing warehouse and genelab, and the 8 _ppGenListing call sites (the brief said six; the candidate found eight and deliberately declined to pin the list in a comment because a stale list inverts the check). Not one assertion I tested was invented.
biggest_gap: The two idle constants at the foot of MythicTransportBridge carry inline fallback literals — collectCdMs: (typeof OP_COLLECT_CD_MS !== 'undefined') ? OP_COLLECT_CD_MS : 6 * 3600000 and accrualCapH: … : 36 — directly under a comment asserting the idle contract is 'PASSED and never redeclared, so transport cannot become a fourth idle policy'. They are a second copy of OP_COLLECT_CD_MS (index.html:79705) and OP_ACCRUAL_CAP_H (79706) with nothing saying which wins if the two ever drift. The fallback is unreachable today because both are top-level consts evaluated far earlier in the same file, so this is a comment slightly overstating what the code enforces rather than a live defect. Fix: drop the literals and let the key be undefined (the module already reads the bridge tolerantly), or annotate the pair as a mirror of 79705-79706 that must move with them.
